items.text: Schwab reported 2026 year-to-date core net new assets of $450 billion (up 27% vs 2025 YTD) and 3.9 million new brokerage accounts (up 15%).
items.quote: CORE NET NEW ASSETS $450B 27% ... NEW BROKERAGE ACCOUNTS 3.9M 15%
